The machine had already finished. The result still followed the wish.

Kevin Trudeau describes a test in which a random number generator ran a billion selections with nobody around. Only after it finished did the researchers bring in a person. They asked the person to want more zeros than ones, and the person did.

Kevin says that in every repeat of the test, the machine had given the number the person wanted more of. He calls it spooky, and says it points to a field where time and space don't work the way we think.

Whether you believe it or not, it is a strange idea to sit with.

When did something go your way and you felt it was not an accident?
